reference_preprocessing: The LoC master is a STEREOGRAPH: two frames on a printed mount with publisher text down both margins and a caption block. Fed whole it risked importing the card format or its lettering into a plate whose NEVER list forbids text. Cropped to ONE clean frame and resized to 1920x1080 before use; all refs pre-sized so the first sets the aspect ratio.
method_note: Gated against the NEVER list AND an exploratory pass ('is anything in frame that is not specified'), because a NEVER list is confirmatory by construction and cannot catch what nobody listed. The exploratory pass is what caught the caption text on the rejected candidates.
subject: WORKMAN — Greek excavation labourer, 1870s. A TYPE, not a portrait.
rejected_why: Rendered caption text FRONT / THREE-QUARTER / PROFILE across the bottom, violating the no-text NEVER; also gave him leg wraps where the brief specifies BARE lower legs.
never_checked: no Evzone parade dress (no 200-pleat ceremonial skirt, no white hose, no pom-pom tsarouchia, no embroidered waistcoat, no fez)
no background scenery, props or other figures
asserts: three views front / three-quarter / profile, same man and clothing across all three
working fustanella: white, pleated, TO THE KNEE, plain, visibly dust-grubby
white wide-sleeved shirt, sleeves pushed up, open neck
bare lower legs, rough leather shoes
